ios.desc:
** Try our XMAS theme piano for free. Our holiday gift to you

DoReMi Zoo is an iOS application built to teach children the basics of playing music in a piano in a rather fun and exciting way. You are able to play the complete Do Re Mi Fa Sol La Ti in various themes with beautiful graphics and fun sounds.

** Features

- Learn to play popular songs.
- Several piano skins to choose from.
- Several piano sounds to choose from.
- Beautiful graphics to keep your children engaged. 
- Helps children learn about music.
 - Helps children learn to play songs on a keyboard. 
- Entertains your children.
 - Easily share your melodies with the world. 
- Easy to use.
- Free :)

** More info 

Remember to visit the "Store" to unlocked wonderful new pianos with different images and sounds. Plus, with any purchase you remove the ads from the application.

Video:    https://vimeo.com/44206053
Twitter:  @abczooapp 
Web:      http://doremizooapp.com
